criteria.name: Deterministic and automatable
criteria.description: Improves reproducible, scriptable, headless, or testable workflows.

criteria.name: Embeddable Rust engine
criteria.description: Can be exposed through a stable library/API without GUI-only coupling.

criteria.name: Modern and efficient rendering
criteria.description: Uses or enables modern GPU, zero-copy, low-overhead, or efficient media paths.

criteria.name: Cross-platform parity
criteria.description: Improves equivalent workflows across supported desktop platforms.

criteria.name: Privacy and user control
criteria.description: Improves local-first operation, explicit consent, safety, or secret handling.

criteria.name: Direct streamer value
criteria.description: Meaningfully improves recording, streaming, scene production, or creator workflow.
